title: Internal: Loyalty Annual Fee Waivers - Payment Review
content:
## Before Granting a Loyalty Waiver

- Before applying an annual fee waiver as a loyalty benefit (reason 'loyalty_benefit'), review the account's last 12 months of payments with get_payment_history_6183 (months: 12).
- If any payment in that period was MISSED, do not apply the waiver; continue with the standard closure process.
- Otherwise, apply the waiver as described in the retention protocol.
